name: MBA Entrance Exam CAT Practice Mock - Practice Test 2
courseName: MBA Entrance Exam CAT Practice Mock

questions.question: If log_2 (x) + log_2 (x - 2) = 3, what is the value of x?
What is the remainder when 2^100 is divided by 3?
In a class of 60 students, 40 like Tea and 30 like Coffee. What is the minimum number of students who like both?
A sum of money doubles itself in 5 years under simple interest. In how many years will it become 4 times?
questions.hint: Doubles in 5 yrs means SI = P, so rate r = 20%. To become 4 times, SI = 3P -> 3P = P * 20 * t / 100 -> t = 15 years.

questions.question: Find the number of zeros at the end of 100! (factorial).
If the roots of x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0 are p and q, what is the value of p^2 + q^2?
A and B start a business with investments in ratio 3:2. If 5% of profit goes to charity and A's share is Rs 855, what is the total profit?
In a group of cows and chickens, the number of legs is 14 more than twice the number of heads. The number of cows is:
What is the probability of choosing a vowel from the word ALGORITHM?
questions.hint: Vowels are A, O, I (3 vowels out of 9 letters).

questions.question: The speed of a boat in still water is 15 km/h and speed of stream is 3 km/h. Time taken to travel 36 km downstream is:
If x + 1/x = 3, what is the value of x^2 + 1/x^2?
The number of ways to arrange the letters of the word CAT is:
If 3 machines can make 3 toys in 3 minutes, how many minutes will it take 100 machines to make 100 toys?
questions.hint: Work rate per machine is constant; 1 machine takes 3 minutes to make 1 toy.

questions.question: A cylinder has height 10cm and radius 7cm. What is its volume (approx)?
questions.hint: Volume = pi * r^2 * h = 22/7 * 49 * 10 = 1540 cubic cm.

questions.question: If the average of four consecutive odd numbers is 16, what is the largest of these numbers?
